is.t: Reconciliation with the 2026 presentation | Country Customs Self-Assessment Program - 2026 UPDATED (PDF, 40 slides)
Blue figures = values typed from the presentation (static). "Workbook (corrected)" columns are LIVE formulas. Status columns compare both at the report date.
Program Scope (32 countries, 61 questions, 36 controls, 7 scopes)
Confirmed by the workbook (Annex 1 is grouped with scope 1 on the slide).

Values reproduce the defective legacy table "1. Data-All Assessments 2026" in which 9 countries were all N/A (Spanish-label defect F01): e.g. 28% N/A in Annex 1, 1. About and 7. Escalations = 9/32 countries. The bar "4. Customs Process Controls (Import Clearence)" duplicates part of scope 4.
Replace with corrected figures (table B below / 03 – Policy Section Analysis).
Identical to the ORIGINAL "1. Data-Control Country Matrix" (all 32 countries match). 179 control cells there were hardcoded N/A; after correction 17 countries change (table A).
Same source as slide 5 (original matrix). 45 control results shown as N/A are now answered (mostly UNDER CONTROL) – see 11 – Change Log, appendix.
Refresh the three tables from the corrected matrix.

Mixes bases: Insufficient counts are question-level (Bahamas 6, Barbados 5, Cayman 3 confirmed) but Bermuda has 6 (slide: 3). Moderate counts are control-level for Nicaragua (6) but Panama = 6 and Guatemala = 5 (slide: 4 / 4). Paraguay (9 Moderate questions) is missing.
Use one basis (questions recommended) – table D.

Built on a legacy pivot with an old control grouping ("Policy Implementation", "F&P and Voluntary Disclosures", "Risk Management - Self-Assessment"). Contradicts slide 11: e.g. Personnel Training shown 91% UNDER CONTROL / 0% Insufficient while 9 countries are Insufficient.
Rebuild from 03 – Policy Section Analysis (36 sections).

Identical to the hardcoded counts of "4.Final-AM Risk Assessment" (stale). After correction 25 of 36 rows change (counts); 4.12, 5.2 and 2.9 move from MODERATE to UNDER CONTROL and 4.3 moves to MODERATE (same 0.91/0.61 thresholds). Moderate weighted 0.5 (Config uses 0.75).
Chart of slide 11 – same stale values.

Values are the hand-typed column K of "5.Compliance 2026". The method matches the workbook score (weighted 1 / 0.75 / 0 over applicable answers) for 26 of 32 countries; 6 are stale: Bermuda 81% (actual 87.2%), Barbados 85% (89.9%), Cayman Islands 97% (94.0%), Venezuela 98% (97.3%), Peru 99% (98.0%), Panama 95% (94.2%). Bermuda and Barbados are therefore not as far behind Bahamas as shown, and Cayman Islands is lower.
Column K now linked to the corrected score; update chart (table E).
Identical to the original matrix. Corrected: CAR Under Control 75% (slide 69%), Canada 83% (slide 75%); N/A share is not shown on the slide.
About the DHL Express Global Customs Compliance Policy
Mislabelled: the table shows each country's OVERALL distribution (same numbers as slide 5), not scope 1. In scope 1 (1.6 / 1.7) only Cayman Islands (Insufficient) and Guatemala (Moderate) have gaps.

Mostly from the original matrix but incomplete and with errors: Bahamas shown 22% Insufficient (data 11%); BVI shown Moderate (data Insufficient); Ecuador listed without gaps; 10 countries with gaps omitted (Bolivia, Chile, Peru, Martinique, Jamaica, Guadeloupe, French Guiana, Canada, Brazil, Curacao).

Lists countries without gaps (Cayman, Curacao, French Guyana, Guadeloupe, Costa Rica) and omits countries with gaps: Trinidad and Tobago (Insufficient, 3.5), Venezuela, Panama, Mexico, Honduras, Dominican Republic (Moderate). Chart legend shows "Series1-4".

Omits countries with Insufficient answers in scope 4 (Mexico, Jamaica, Barbados) and 9 countries with Moderate answers; lists Honduras, Uruguay and Trinidad which have no gap there. Bahamas shown 14% Insufficient (data 21%).
Curacao and Honduras have no gap in 5.1 / 5.2; USA (5.1) and Dominican Republic (5.2) are the Moderate ones, with Nicaragua.
Contains a pivot "Grand Total" row; omits Uruguay and Paraguay (Moderate on Q60). N/A list differs from data (El Salvador, Jamaica, Bahamas, Barbados, BVI declare N/A).

Does not match 2026 answers: data shows Insufficient = Barbados, Bermuda, Cayman Islands, Curacao and Moderate = 13 countries (see table D). Only Chile, Jamaica, Dominican Republic and Cayman Islands coincide with the slide.
Areas of opportunity – Key Countries boxes
Country lists do not match the 2026 answers nor the prior snapshot – see table D for each topic.
Update the boxes (live lists in table D).

"4.11 Post Clearence Modification" is mislabelled (4.11 = Unauthorized Release; PCM = 4.8). The 4.11 regional actions in "Regional Actions Draft" are not shown. "Countries with more opportunities" (Nicaragua, BVI, Haiti, El Salvador, Cayman) does not match the data: lowest scores are Bermuda, Bahamas, Barbados, then Nicaragua and Paraguay; El Salvador is Strong (98%).
Correct label, add URL actions, update country list from 02 – Country Ranking.
